purpose: Test whether point-in-time profitable revenue growth plus ROE ranking produces after-cost long-only 20-session excess returns.

period.exclusions: Do not use 2023/24 opened low-vol and reversal experiments, 2025/26 retrospective growth-ROE, 2026 frozen 122/8 or E fold3/fold4.
period.oos_claim: historical predeclared time-split only; two years cannot establish repeatable independent alpha

universe.filing_eligibility: Q3 announcement date strictly before November 15 of the same year; exclude any with earliest qualifying vendor date after November 14; use earliest recorded financial values, never later revisions
universe.listing: Listed on as-of date and >=365 calendar days since independently confirmed listing start; contemporaneous securities identity and ST status required
universe.missing_or_uncertain: Exclude with explicit per-issuer reason and report counts; if full point-in-time universe / delisted names / ST history cannot be authenticated, mark EVIDENCE_BLOCKED, not OOS
universe.survivorship: Require membership including delisted instruments rather than today's list

hypothesis.rank: Within eligible names compute descending percentile rank of or_yoy and roe_waa independently, score=0.5*each; tie-break ascending canonical exchange+6digit ticker
hypothesis.portfolio: Top min(10,ceil(0.05*N)) names; if N<30, label insufficient and do not score experiment
hypothesis.adaptation: No threshold changes, additional factors, reverse-position choice or optimization after outcome access

execution.decision: November 15 at 20:00 Asia/Shanghai, from only filings with notice <= November 14; if Nov15 a nontrading day, still use Nov15 20:00 information cutoff
execution.entry: First exchange trading session strictly after November 15: unadjusted official opening auction price if buyable; no assumed fill if limit-up/halt/missing
execution.exit: 20th actual exchange session counting entry as session 1, official close if sellable; respect Mainland A-share T+1; if limit-down/halt, hold until independently evidenced first tradable closing session, otherwise mark unresolved
execution.corporate_actions: Apply cash dividends, splits, rights and delisting proceeds when actually held; use verified transaction-price and corporate-action vintages; never mix raw and adjusted prices
execution.missing_fills: Do not skip a session, substitute another name or assume executable fills; failed price/fill evidence => INCOMPLETE
execution.allocation: Equal weight among up to 10 selected at entry, board-lot round down (mainboard 100-share lots); retain residual cash

evaluation.primary: Equal-initial-capital-weight realized whole portfolio after-cost 20-session total return minus CSI300 total-return index for exactly matched dates; residual cash earns zero
evaluation.benchmark: CSI300 total-return index H00300.CSI, confirmed exact security/date, no synthetic price-only replacement
secondary: tradeable selected count and missing fractions
portfolio drawdown only from executed chronological path
evaluation.gate: Both evaluation years must have fully authenticated sources and >0 after-cost benchmark-relative excess, plus positive pooled excess, else FAIL_OR_INSUFFICIENT; passing this limited gate only supports further independent replication, never BUY authorization

access_control.after_rule_freeze_only: Do not inspect evaluation-period price outcomes until issuer PIT source provenance and tradeability prerequisites for the evaluation set are independently checked and reported

stop_rule: If full historical issuer/st status, original-as-published finances, price and corporate action source, executable lot/cost assumptions or CSI300 TR missing, report EVIDENCE_BLOCKED and do not claim strategy performance.
